products.title: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and creamy perfume for women who enjoy warm vanilla scents with a tropical twist. The top notes are the gentle combination of orchid, heliotrope and a bit of fresh tangerine. The middle notes deliver the sweetness of the gourmand and the juiciness of the tropical fruits mixed. Finally, the fragrance dries down to a warm and comforting base of vanilla, soft musk and sandalwood that keeps the smoothness on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and comforting perfume that wraps you in a soft, cozy scent. Perfume for women, this scent feels like a warm dessert in a bottle. The aroma starts with the notes of caramel, milk and sugar, which create a smooth and creamy first impression. Then it changes to a floral and golden scent with honey and white flowers while the base floats away into vanilla, praline and musk.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fun and playful perfume made for women who love soft, fruity scents with a candy twist. The opening provides a delightful blend of black currant and green tangerine, which is a very juicy one. A pop of sweet strawberry fizz combined with a pale floral gardenia note resides in the heart. The final stage of the perfume is warm and creamy, with notes of vanilla, musk, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Burberry Goddess Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Goddess EDP Spray is a gourmand aromatic fragrance for women, launched in 2023. The fragrance stands out with a triple vanilla infusion, offering a warm and creamy sweetness to the overall scent. The fresh herbal touch of lavender adds to the depth and complexity of the fragrance and makes it suitable for colder seasons of the year or special occasions.

products.title: Lattafa Victoria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Victoria Eau de Parfum is a sweet and soft floral-fruity unisex scent that feels warm, cozy and a bit yummy. It opens with a bright and creamy smell of lemon meringue pie, moves into a soft neroli heart and dries down into a sweet vanilla base.

products.title: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum is a sweet, floral and fruity women’s perfume for those who like soft yet noticeable scents. It opens with juicy, fruity notes like peach, red mandarin and nectar, giving a fresh, sweet feel. The middle notes bring floral charm with jasmine, white flowers and creamy vanilla sugar. In the base, maple, syrup, amber and precious woods mix to create a warm sugary finish.

products.title: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Goddess Intense Perfume for Women by Burberry is the brand’s standout oriental gourmand fragrance, launched in 2024. The scent has a rich and sweet aroma of a quartet of vanillas and lavender, making it perfect for those who love sophistication. The fragrance is also renowned for being a more intense interpretation of Burberry Goddess EDP, with the earthy accords giving it a more warmer, woodier and long-lasting profile.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and playful scent made for women who enjoy dessert like perfumes. It opens with juicy pear and fluffy whipped cream notes that feel soft and tasty. The heart has floral jasmine and ylang ylang mixed with warm cashmeran, which adds a cozy feel. The base dries down to smooth vanilla, marshmallow and sandalwood, leaving a sugary, soft and comforting trail that feels feminine and addictive.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Lattafa Petra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Petra Eau de Perrier by Lattafa Perfumes is a creamy and sweet unisex perfume that is warm and a tad bit boozy. The initial spray introduces the splendid rum and juicy plum, which add a dark fruity touch to this spray. Then there comes tuberose and coconut, and it is soft and creamy. The smooth sweet finish of vanilla, musk and praline in the base remains hours long.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume made for people who enjoy sweet citrus scents with a warm touch. It opens fresh and clean with lavender, bergamot and lemon, which feels bright and uplifting from the first spray. In the middle, the scent becomes soft and cozy with honey, cinnamon, jasmine and cashmeran, giving it a slightly sweet, creamy feel. The base is warm and addictive with vanilla, tobacco leaf and tonka bean.

products.title: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 is a sweet, creamy, and playful scent that is reminiscent of cold pistachio ice cream on a hot summer day. The fragrance starts with a nutty mix of pistachio, hazelnut, and a soft, cold ice-cream vibe that appeals and tempts. Then it proceeds to a fruity floral heart where jasmine, white peach, and pear are the main contributors and they deliver smooth and fresh sweetness. The last layer consists of whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, and cacao, which gives the skin a warm, sweet, and cozy feel. It’s a happy gourmand scent for anyone whose taste in perfumes swings to the side of creamy, sweet, and dessert-like ones.

products.title: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, fruity and floral scent with a creamy gourmand twist. Launched in 2024, this fragrance opens with fresh, juicy notes of coconut water, raspberry and pear that feel light and happy. The heart blooms with jasmine and freesia, giving a gentle floral touch. The dry down turns warm and tasty with macarons, musk and amber, making the scent cozy, smooth and slightly dessert like but not heavy.

products.title: Kayali Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a playful and sweet perfume that resembles a candy shop visit. The fragrance opens with a combination of creamy vanilla, juicy pear, and soft marshmallow, which gives the scent a warm sugary start. Soon the fragrance becomes even sweeter with the addition of bubble gum, jelly bean, and caramel, making it taste yummy and young. The base turns warm and comfortable with sugar, tonka, patchouli, and soft woods that linger on the skin for a long time. It is a great choice for people who are into sweet, girlish, and cozy fragrances.

products.title: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, gourmand scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, it brings a delicious blend of caramel and milk in the opening, followed by soft notes of tonka bean and honey in the middle. The drydown settles into a warm base of vanilla and white musk, giving it a smooth, cozy finish that feels comforting and addictive.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum is a woody aromatic fragrance designed for men who love deep and daring scents. It was launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin. The perfume starts with spicy pink pepper and is followed by the calming and fresh touch of lavender then dries down to a unique warm base of cacao. The mix gives a balance of spicy, floral and gourmand notes making it a modern perfume for men.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and very feminine fragrance made for women who enjoy soft gourmand scents. It opens with juicy fruits and sweetness that feels bright and happy from the first spray. The heart is floral and creamy, giving it a smooth and elegant touch without feeling heavy. As it settles, Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum turns warm and comforting base with vanilla and soft musk.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a sweet, soft and elegant women's fragrance. It opens with juicy fruity notes of peach, orange and bergamot mixed with fresh green accords that feel bright and happy. The heart comes with creamy white florals like jasmine, tuberose and orchid blended with heliotrope and lily-of-the-valley, giving a powdery, feminine touch. The dry down is warm and cozy with caramel, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and patchouli creating a sweet yet classy scent trail that feels smooth and comforting.

products.title: Khadlaj Nuha Vanilla Pearl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Perfumes Nuha Vanilla Pearl is a women's fragrance, Floral Fruity Gourmand. This is a new fragrance. In 2025, Nuha Vanilla Pearl was introduced. It begins with plump blackcurrant and strawberry mixed with sweet freesia. The heart also includes raspberry, cashmere wood and magnolia giving a creamy floral flavor. Its base is sweet and vanilla, caramel and moss-flavoured with a smooth and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Kayali Yum Bougee Marshmallow 81 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Boujee Marshmallow Eau de Parfum is a women's fragrance, a floral, fruity gourmand perfume. It was initiated in 2024 and designed by Gabriela Chelariu. It is a sweet, creamy and playful perfume that is targeted at people who are fond of sweet and tender aromatic fragrances. It is youthful, entertaining and somewhat luxurious.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum is a dreamy, modern floral perfume designed for the confident woman who loves sweetness with a touch of freshness. Inspired by the beauty of the exotic vanilla orchid, this fragrance mixes delicious vanilla with soft floral notes and a light, airy finish.

Wearing Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid feels like stepping into a magical garden filled with blooming orchids and a sweet breeze. It’s elegant, youthful, and perfect for women who want to feel fresh yet luxurious every day.

products.title: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum is a sweet, playful women’s perfume. It opens with a strong cherry feel that smells juicy, a little boozy and slightly nutty. As it settles, soft fruits and florals come out, making it feel romantic and smooth. The base is warm, creamy and comforting with vanilla and woods that stay close to the skin. This perfume feels fun, cozy and perfect for someone who loves sweet cherry based scents.

products.title: Mancera  Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and fruity unisex perfume. This fragrance opens with a blast of juicy fruits that feel bright, fresh and mouth watering. It has a sweet vibe but still feels classy and smooth. As the perfume settles, soft floral notes start to appear and balance the sweetness very well. The dry down is creamy, warm and musky, which stays on the skin for many hours. Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is bold, strong and very long lasting, perfect for people who love fruity and sweet perfumes with power.

products.title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir perfume is a women's fragrance that is sweet, bold, and playful with a rich and glamorous feeling. It starts with juicy wild berries along with a hint of mandarin orange and the impression is of freshness and fun. The heart of the fragrance consists of gardenia, jasmine, and honeysuckle which form the base of the creamy floral smell. The end notes of caramel, vanilla, amber, and sandalwood blend together to form a warm, sweet, and smooth base that lasts for many hours. The scent is perfect for women who love sweet, flirty, and feminine fragrances but with a little depth.

products.title: Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum is a delightfully playful and flirty fragrance that is as charming as its name. This scent is a candy-lover's dream, bottling the feeling of pure joy and irresistible sweetness. It’s designed for the woman who is fun-loving, confident, and loves to express her sweet side.

Sweet Like Candy smells like a delicious treat you can wear. It has a youthful, happy, and vibrant charm that is perfect for everyday wear. A single spray of Ariana Grande's Sweet Like Candy will wrap you in a cloud of sugary bliss, making you feel cheerful and irresistible.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and modern unisex perfume from the house of Arabiyat Prestige. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright and playful but also warm at the same time. It begins with rich fruits and citrus flavors, which are vibrant and vivid. As it settles, soft florals and a creamy sweetness start to show, making it smooth and pleasing. The base is warm and woody and a little sweet, making the perfume to be in balance and very comfortable.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and elegant perfume made for women who love floral scents with a creamy touch. It opens fresh and juicy with citrus fruits and gradually turns into a smooth mix of jasmine, fruits and coconut. The base feels warm and comforting with vanilla and amber, making it ideal for daily wear and unique moments too. It smells classy but is still easy to wear, not heavy at all.

products.title: Lattafa Mashmoom Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Mashmoom by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Mashmoom was launched in 2025. Top notes are Rose and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel and Peony; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

products.title: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and soft perfume that is designed to suit women who place a premium on modern and great style perfumes. The perfume opens with light-hearted and sweet scents of strawberry and raspberry, and cherry berry. The violet and jasmine floral notes come out to produce a feminine touch. Vanilla and musk mixed with the woody in the base notes of the fragrance are warm and smooth on the skin all day long.

products.title: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is soft, sweet, and cheerful which is made for women loving the aroma of fresh tropical fruits. The fragrance opens with wild berries and green notes which are light and playful. Eventually, it becomes creamy with the addition of coconut, orange blossom, and water lily, thus a beach-like setting is created. The dry down has vanilla, tonka bean, and musk that are close to the skin and are warm, smooth, and comforting. This perfume has a relaxing, feminine and casual vibe which is perfect for everyday use.

products.title: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum is a pleasant and luxurious women's perfume that is fruity, flowery and slightly creamy. It starts and becomes sunny and fatty, but then gradually becomes gentle and cosy to the skin. The rose, praline and vanilla blend make it very rich and smooth. It is a stylish and at the same time fun smell that will appeal to the women who enjoy sweet scents and have a bold flavour.

products.title: Lattafa Esraa Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Esraa by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Esraa was launched in 2025. Top notes are Blackcurrant, Lychee and Apple; middle notes are Rose, Red Fruits and Raspberry; base notes are Musk, Caramel and Vanilla.

products.title: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey Body & Hand Wash
products.body_html: Nectarine Blossom & Honey by Jo Malone London is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. Nectarine Blossom & Honey was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jo Malone. Top notes are Green Notes, Black Currant and Petitgrain; middle notes are Nectarine and Black locust; base notes are Peach, Plum and Vetiver.
